sellThenNews.description: r/wallstreetbets 2026 年 7 月 8 日情绪分析。讨论最多的股票代码：SPY、MU、META、SNDK、NBIS。人工智能生成的零售流程、牛市/熊市叙述和关键主题的摘要。

sections.overview:
1. 整体市场概况和情绪

今日主要事件：

  • Trump declares the ceasefire with Iran “over,” threatens another strike tonight: At the NATO summit in Ankara, Trump said negotiations were a “waste of time,” called Iran “scum,” and said the U.S. military is “very likely to strike again tonight,” “may take Kharg Island,” and threatened to restart a naval blockade of the Strait of Hormuz. Overnight, the U.S. military had already carried out retaliatory bombing of Iran after three oil tankers were attacked. As of now, the broader market is weaker across the board: SPY 741.75 (-0.81%, approaching the intraday low of 741.63), QQQ 704.84 (-0.65%), DIA 521.45 (-1.33%), IWM 292.55 (-1.23%).
  • Oil prices surge; U.S. revokes Iran oil waiver: The Treasury revoked sanctions waivers allowing Iranian oil to enter global markets. WTI at one point jumped about 5-6% to above $74, while Brent approached $78. USO 113.74 (+4.39%), XOM +0.74%.
  • Semiconductors/memory open with a V-shaped rebound after overnight plunge: MU fell to 902 premarket, surged above 958 intraday, and has now pulled back to 931.59 (-0.86%); SNDK spiked to 1700 before trading at 1641.80 (+1.48%); AVGO 386.56 (+4.33%, residual momentum from the large Apple order) is leading, while NBIS +4.45% and CRWV +3.35% are also strong. SOXL has retreated from a +9% high to roughly flat.
  • Mega-cap tech broadly leads declines: MSFT 383.36 (-1.38%, the community’s top castoff “microslop”), META 602.11 (-2.16%), GOOGL -1.37%, TSLA 392.63 (-2.57%), AMZN -1.48%, PLTR 128.16 (-4.62%), ORCL -2.22%, INTC -4.14%. BABA is bucking the trend at +10.69%, continuing its independent move.
  • Precious metals and defense weaken; safe-haven trade fails: GLD -1.85%, SLV -4.22%, GS -2.38%, UVXY +5.69%.
  • June FOMC meeting minutes to be released today at 14:00 ET (not a rate decision): Under Warsh, the dot plot is hawkish: among 19 members, 9 expect at least one rate hike this year, 8 expect no change, and 1 expects a cut. The market generally expects limited informational value from the minutes.

社区氛围：整体基调是“混乱+反射性看涨”的混乱组合——一夜之间的“世界末日/抛售一切”恐慌很快就被半导体开盘的V形反弹所影响。多头高喊“战争就是牛”，而看跌的看跌期权则再次被“火箭发射器”炸毁。尽管如此，SPY 仍略低，大型股呈深红色，社区不断在“我们回来了”和“一切都结束了”之间摇摆不定。

恐惧/贪婪：45左右（有些恐惧，但正在迅速恢复）。 VIX 代理 UVXY +5.7% 显示恐惧依然存在，但半导体市场相对大盘转绿，让“逢低买入人群”占据了上风。

情绪与实际市场行为：经典的背离仍在继续——社区中充满了诸如“神圣的熊市陷阱”和“恭喜下跌的买家”之类的胜利呼喊，但实际大盘的 SPY 仍处于低点附近 -0.81%，七巨头普遍走软。只有SNDK/AVGO/NBIS/BABA等少数几个名字真正实现了绿色化。社区将“我的内存库存是绿色的”误认为是“市场是绿色的”。
